title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
statement_short: Evaluate the value of an arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation (postfix notation). Valid operators are '+', '-', '\*', and '/'. Division between two integers truncates toward zero.
constraints: 1 <= tokens.length <= 10^4, tokens[i] is an operator '+', '-', '\*', '/' or an integer in range [-200, 200]
hint: Token array length up to 10^4 allows an O(n) single pass, evaluating operands using a stack.
why_not: Right: Stack pushes numeric operands and pops the top two numbers whenever an operator is encountered to compute results in O(n) time and O(n) space. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming caches subproblem results, whereas postfix evaluation requires immediate stack-based evaluation. Not Math / Geometry: Arithmetic evaluation follows postfix order stack rules rather than static geometric formulas. Not Tree DFS: Expression tree traversal works, but flat stack processing avoids building explicit tree nodes.
